verdict.rationale: Infrastructure Manager offers declarative Terraform-based configuration with preview deployments to review changes before applying (docs-5, docs-6), which touches on review-before-apply, but there is no documented versioning system or explicit rollback capability for automations/workflows themselves. Missing for 10: explicit version history/audit trail for automations, a documented rollback mechanism, and evidence tied to AI-native workflow automation rather than generic infra-as-code.
